sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a new open-weight, 125B parameter MoE multimodal model from Qwen. Built on the new Qwen4 architecture, it supports a 262K context window and advanced reasoning. sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a multimodal, ultra-sparse Mixture-of-Experts model. It has 125B parameters, including an additional 51B N-gram embedding table, while activating 6B parameters per token. The architecture combines four main ideas: GDN + QSA: three of every four layers use Gated DeltaNet to compress history; the fourth uses Qwen Sparse Attention for precise long-range retrieval ...
